name: ReleaseOwnedHandlePair
signature: inline void* load_ptr(const void* base, std::size_t off)
summary: Frees the handle stored at self+0x1cc (and its inner handle at +0xc, if set), then clears the slot.

fields.type: void* field_0x1cc (pointer to a handle-holder object; freed via
fields.name: GlobalFree)

fields.type: HGLOBAL field_0x0c (inner handle of the holder object; freed via GlobalFree if
fields.name: non-null)
